ledger_id_note: the highest WP in README / wiki / ledger at 2026-10-25 is WP63; the three lanes ahead of this one on the shared box take WP64-WP66, so this study takes the fourth, WP67
question: Can a trapped warmup chain be detected at the end of the first slow adaptation window by a step rule (its step far below the other chains') and restarted from the best of a fresh independent best-of-16 candidate pool, so that the hudson_lynx_hare-lotka_volterra trapped-chain count falls from WP57's 2/48 toward 0, without changing any draw on runs where no chain is flagged, and without losing gates or more than 5 % ESS per gradient on six house posteriordb models?
library_commit: 8887a0f0 (wt/trapped-chain: research-only WarmupConfig::with_trapped_chain_restart, TrappedChainRestartConfig::step_rule(), TrappedChainCheck; default None; no default changed; fingerprints untouched)

machine.box: AWS EC2 c7a.4xlarge, 16 dedicated AMD cores (no SMT), 32 GB, Ubuntu 24.04, Rust 1.88.0, Python 3.12.3
machine.lane: lane 4, cores 12-15; every build and cell prefixed with taskset -c 12-15; RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, TMPDIR under the lane
machine.co_tenancy: three other lanes run concurrently on cores 0-11 (shared L3 and memory bandwidth): wall-clock numbers are 'pinned, co-tenanted'; gradient counts, ESS per gradient, draw hashes and pass counts are unaffected by co-tenancy

models_build: prepare_models.py: Stan programs and data copied from the shared read-only posteriordb checkout, libraries built with BridgeStan 2.9.0 source (release tarball sha256 b6034f83fb2ffb71ce7be9525b7dded1a225e9a4eaf4b75d4c7e97e3ade05a4c) under the lane, gcc 13.3.0, no STAN_THREADS; hashes in artifacts/models.json

posteriordb.access: read-only shared checkout; reference draws read directly from reference_posteriors/draws/draws/*.json.zip

sampler: owalnuts::sampler at the library commit: Metric::diagonal() (default), Tuning::default() (RejectLeaf), Limits::admit_worst_case(), 4 chains x 1,000 warmup / 1,000 draws, 4 threads, starts Init::default() = Init::best_of(16) drawn by candidate_starts exactly as Sampler::run_with_init; ReplicatedStanTarget construct seed 1

detector.statistic: s_c = the step size used by chain c's transition 99 (TransitionDiagnostics::step_size), the last transition of the first slow metric window (transitions 75..99 of Stan's 1,000-transition schedule)
detector.reference: m = median of s_c over the 4 chains (mean of the middle two)
detector.rule: flag chain c iff s_c < 0.1 x m
detector.when: once, after every chain has completed transition 99 (the chains are synchronised there and nowhere else)
detector.skip: no check if fewer than 3 chains, if the first slow window has fewer than 10 transitions or ends after warmup, or if any s_c is not finite and positive
detector.provenance: the WP33/WP44 step rule (ratio 0.1, frozen since WP33), applied at the end of S1 as WP57 emulated it; WP57's S1 emulation flagged 10/10 trapped or stalled chains and 0/139 healthy chains (healthy ratios >= 0.304, trapped <= 0.027); the threshold is not re-tuned

restart_action.what: the flagged chain's run is discarded (its transitions 0..99 are abandoned; their target calls stay in the run's call count) and the chain reruns the full 1,000 + 1,000 schedule from transition 0
restart_action.start: the highest-log-density of 16 fresh evaluable uniform(-2, 2) candidates (up to 100 draws each), drawn by sampler::candidate_starts for one chain with seed splitmix64(base_seed ^ TRAPPED_CHAIN_RESTART_SEED_TAG) + chain
restart_action.state: initial metric (identity), initial step (Tuning step 0.5), fresh dual averaging, fresh RNG stream seed splitmix64(chain_seed ^ TRAPPED_CHAIN_RESTART_SEED_TAG); nothing copied from any other chain
restart_action.limits: at most one restart per chain; the restarted chain is not checked again
restart_action.telemetry: RunTelemetry::trapped_chain_checks on every chain (score, median, threshold, flag) and, on a restarted chain, the abandoned run's target calls, the replacement start, its log density and evaluation count, and the new seed

blocks.name: L1
blocks.note: declared targeted replication (NOT fresh): WP57's block A seeds, where defaults trapped 2/48 chains (5701103 chain 3, 5701106 chain 2) on Windows; the Linux BridgeStan build may not reproduce those trajectories

blocks.name: L2
blocks.note: fresh seeds, secondary; pooled with L1 for the efficacy clause

cell_order: L1 (seeds ascending; per seed defaults then restart), then R (models in listed order, seeds ascending, per seed defaults then restart), then L2 (as L1). Strictly sequential, one harness process per cell, one cell at a time, no cell rerun; failures are results.
seeds_verified_unused: git grep -w over the repository at a49df800 and the protocol.json / PREREGISTRATION.md of every sibling worktree find no occurrence of 6701201-6701212, 6701301-6701303 or 6709901
smoke: non-evidence, before the first cell: lotka seed 6709901, defaults vs restart vs custom_noop vs --plain; report the draw hashes; and eight_schools_centered seed 6709901 defaults vs restart through pdb-cell

gates.note: ArviZ 0.23.4 rank R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS (0.05/0.95), mean MCSE on every posteriordb reference parameter (columns of the reference draws; draws constrained by BridgeStan param_constrain with transformed parameters); z = (mean - ref mean) / sqrt(mcse^2 + ref mcse^2). No CmdStan arm. A cell that errors or times out fails every gate.

definitions.chain_shift: per chain, max over reference parameters of |chain mean - reference mean| / reference SD
definitions.trapped_chain: a chain of a completed cell with chain_shift > 3 (the WP44/WP52 'off reference' rule); in a cell that did not complete, every chain that had not finished its transitions (from the streamed telemetry); this outcome is defined without the detector
definitions.flagged_chain: restart arm: a chain whose TrappedChainCheck says restarted; defaults arm (emulated): the same rule applied to the defaults run's step at transition 99 (from chains_data step_at_transition_99, or the streamed telemetry if the cell did not complete)
definitions.firing_cell: a restart-arm cell with at least one flagged chain
definitions.wrong_chain_cell: a completed cell with some chain_shift > 3
definitions.efficiency: per cell min over reference parameters of bulk ESS / total target calls (start search, abandoned runs and replacement pools included); per model the geometric mean over seeds where both arms completed; ratio restart / defaults per model; geometric mean over the six models

predictions.P1: L1 defaults has 1-3 trapped chains of 48 (WP57 saw 2; cross-platform floating point may move them)
predictions.P2: L1 restart has at most 1 trapped chain of 48 (expected 0)
predictions.P3: the detector flags every defaults-arm trapped chain of the lotka blocks that reached transition 99 (sensitivity 1) and at most 1 chain of all lotka defaults chains that is not trapped
predictions.P4: fingerprint: on every cell (lotka and regression) the restart arm's flagged set equals the defaults arm's emulated set; every non-firing cell is bit-identical to defaults (all-chain draw hash and total target calls); every non-flagged chain of a firing cell is bit-identical per chain (draw hash and per-chain target calls)
predictions.P5: the detector fires on 0 of the 18 regression cells, so the regression arm is identical (equal pass counts, efficiency ratio exactly 1)
predictions.P6: pooled over L1 and L2, the restart arm spends fewer total target calls than defaults when at least one restart occurs
predictions.P7: a restarted chain ends trapped in at most 1 case

decision_rule.E_efficacy: pooled over L1 and L2 (96 chains per arm): defaults has >= 2 trapped chains and restart has at most floor(defaults / 2); if defaults has < 2 trapped chains pooled, efficacy is not evaluable and the rule cannot pass (verdict: inconclusive, no events)
decision_rule.F_fingerprint: P4 holds on every cell, without exception; any failure is an implementation fault and the verdict is 'failed (implementation)' whatever else holds
decision_rule.G_lotka_gates: lotka cells passing every gate (incl. max |z| <= 4): restart >= defaults, pooled over L1 and L2
decision_rule.R1_regression_passes: regression cells passing every gate: restart >= defaults (of 18)
decision_rule.R2_regression_efficiency: geometric mean over the six models of the restart / defaults efficiency ratio >= 0.95
decision_rule.R3_regression_safety: wrong-chain cells in R: restart <= defaults
decision_rule.verdict: SUPPORTED iff E, F, G, R1, R2 and R3 all hold; then recommend a default-flip confirmation study (fresh seeds, broader posteriordb, the house rule that any default flip needs a v7-style validation); otherwise NOT SUPPORTED (or INCONCLUSIVE / FAILED (implementation) as above) and no default change is proposed
